screenplay_source.heading: INT. INDEPENDENT JUDICIAL MEDICAL CENTRE – INTERVIEW ROOM – DAWN

anaadhi.hair: dense voluminous medium-long hair with natural lift and side taper

props.INTAKE_FORM: physical; authorised readable identity fields/values only
props.FIRST_VICTIM_FILE: physical; MALLAYYA only readable victim name
props.FOUR_ROAD_EXTERIOR: exactly four physical roads with ordinary vehicles

shots.purpose: cut from SC099B handwritten MALLAYYA into the real dawn interview room
shots.subject_placement: one table and two chairs centered; Anaadhi and Clinician opposed; Advocate by wall; open door and wide window readable
shots.depth_plan: room shell / table participants / open door officers
shots.visual_prompt: A deliberately simple judicial medical interview room at dawn: one table, exactly two chairs, one wide window and an open door. Anaadhi sits opposite an Independent Clinician; a Legal Advocate stands by the wall; two court officers remain outside, visible but not looming.
shots.negative_constraints: no SC099B writing room; no interrogation architecture; no restraints; no extra furniture; no Paraane emblem; no dramatic prison lighting

shots.purpose: establish two court officers outside as visible but non-looming
shots.subject_placement: open doorway centered; two officers outside with respectful distance
shots.visual_prompt: View from inside toward the physically open doorway; exactly two court officers remain outside at a respectful distance, visible but not looming.
shots.negative_constraints: no armed intimidation pose; no officer inside room; no bars; no closed door; no freedom halo
shots.continuity_anchor: two officers outside visible not looming

shots.purpose: establish Anaadhi unrestrained in final B34 state
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi center-left at table
shots.depth_plan: Anaadhi / table edge / wide-window dawn softness
shots.orientation_notes: final state begins; SC099B recovery look no longer authoritative
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi sits without restraints, age 27 and 193 cm, lean-defined and masculine after recovery, with dense voluminous medium-long hair, natural lift and side taper, and a medium-full beard with disciplined moustache. His final garment remains deliberately unspecified as a continuity-controlled unresolved element.
shots.negative_constraints: no handcuffs; no SC099B recovery placeholder; no shaved scalp; no invented uniform/robe/prison clothing; no heroic dominance pose

shots.purpose: preserve healed surgical-scar state without inventing garment exposure
shots.subject_placement: relaxed hands and upper torso composition
shots.orientation_notes: scar state canonical whether or not garment permits direct visibility
shots.visual_prompt: A restrained detail of Anaadhi's recovered body and relaxed hands at the table; long healed surgical scars are continuity truth, but do not invent garment cut or exposed-scar placement beyond what a later approved garment permits.
shots.negative_constraints: no fresh wounds; no bandages; no forced bare torso; no invented costume

shots.purpose: establish Clinician opposite and Legal Advocate by wall
shots.subject_placement: Clinician seated opposite; Advocate standing by wall
shots.depth_plan: Anaadhi shoulder / Clinician / Advocate wall position
shots.visual_prompt: Independent Clinician sits opposite Anaadhi at the only table; Legal Advocate is present by the wall, observant but not dominating.
shots.negative_constraints: no extra clinician; no judge; no police inside room; no medical machinery spectacle

shots.purpose: Clinician places intake form on table
shots.subject_placement: intake form centered between participants
shots.depth_plan: form / Clinician hand / Anaadhi soft beyond
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician places a simple intake form on the table between herself and Anaadhi.
shots.negative_constraints: no invented court seal; no Paraane logo; no readable extra fields; no holographic form

shots.purpose: Clinician states interview is separate from criminal statement
shots.subject_placement: Clinician center
shots.visual_prompt: The Independent Clinician calmly explains the procedural boundary of the interview.
shots.negative_constraints: no prosecutor tone; no intimidation; no invented legal text
dialogue: INDEPENDENT CLINICIAN: This interview is separate from your criminal statement.

shots.purpose: Anaadhi says I understand
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi center
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi answers simply, composed and physically imposing without using size to control the room.
shots.negative_constraints: no threatening lean; no smile of triumph; no alternate Earth

shots.purpose: Clinician says he may stop interview whenever he wants
shots.subject_placement: Clinician center; form lower frame
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician states that Anaadhi may stop the interview whenever he wants; the open door remains physically visible in depth.
shots.negative_constraints: no freedom symbolism; no glowing doorway; no officer intrusion
dialogue: INDEPENDENT CLINICIAN: You may stop this interview whenever you want.

shots.purpose: Anaadhi notes court may still keep him there
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi center; doorway peripheral
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi looks toward the real open door only peripherally as he points out that the court may still keep him here.
shots.negative_constraints: no escape intent; no bars; no supernatural road
dialogue: ANAADHI: But the court may still keep me here.

shots.purpose: Legal Advocate confirms yes
shots.subject_placement: Advocate by wall
shots.visual_prompt: The Legal Advocate, still by the wall, gives a simple factual confirmation.
shots.negative_constraints: no judge costume invention; no dramatic reaction; no extra legal papers

shots.purpose: Anaadhi says do not call that door freedom
shots.framing: medium close with open door in same composition
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi foreground left; open door background right
shots.orientation_notes: door remains architecture, not literal symbol effect
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi states the distinction while the physically open door remains visible behind him as ordinary architecture.
shots.negative_constraints: no glowing freedom doorway; no closed door; no road visible through door; no supernatural metaphor visualisation
shots.continuity_anchor: Then do not call that door freedom
dialogue: ANAADHI: Then do not call that door freedom.

shots.purpose: Clinician looks toward open doorway
shots.subject_placement: Clinician foreground; doorway in sightline
shots.depth_plan: Clinician / doorway / two officers far outside
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician looks toward the physically open doorway and the two distant officers outside, considering Anaadhi's wording.
shots.negative_constraints: no looming officers; no symbolic lighting change

shots.purpose: Clinician answers I will not
shots.subject_placement: Clinician center
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician returns her gaze to Anaadhi and answers without defensiveness.
shots.negative_constraints: no smile; no dramatic music cue; no legal authority display

shots.purpose: Clinician turns form toward Anaadhi
shots.subject_placement: form rotates toward Anaadhi; both hands visible
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician physically turns the intake form toward Anaadhi across the table.
shots.negative_constraints: no extra forms; no readable invented fields

shots.purpose: Clinician invites Anaadhi to fill identity section himself
shots.subject_placement: Clinician and Anaadhi balanced; form between
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician offers Anaadhi control of the identity section by placing the form within his reach.
shots.negative_constraints: no forced hand movement; no symbolic chains breaking
dialogue: INDEPENDENT CLINICIAN: You may fill in the identity section yourself.

shots.purpose: Anaadhi takes pen
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi hand closes gently around pen
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi calmly takes the pen from the table; the same hand that once held tools and weapons now holds an ordinary writing instrument without tension.
shots.negative_constraints: no weapon association insert; no scar exaggeration; no tremor invention

shots.purpose: write NAME ANAADHI
shots.subject_placement: NAME field and handwritten ANAADHI legible; surrounding fields cropped/soft
shots.visual_prompt: Close on the intake form as Anaadhi writes the authorised identity value ANAADHI under NAME.
shots.negative_constraints: no extra readable fields; no invented ID number/date/case number; no decorative handwriting text

shots.purpose: pause before MOTHER
shots.subject_placement: pen paused foreground; Anaadhi face behind
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi pauses before the MOTHER field; keep the pause human and still, without apparition or flashback.
shots.negative_constraints: no Janne apparition; no childhood flash; no Parallel Earth

shots.purpose: write MOTHER JANNE
shots.subject_placement: MOTHER field and JANNE legible
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi writes the authorised value JANNE under MOTHER after the pause.
shots.negative_constraints: no extra readable form content; no photo insertion; no invented surname

shots.purpose: longer pause before FATHER
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi profile; pen held over form
shots.orientation_notes: longer screenplay pause than mother field
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi holds a longer pause before the FATHER field, remaining controlled and present in the real room.
shots.negative_constraints: no Parvaran apparition; no flashback; no judgmental reaction from others

shots.purpose: write FATHER PARVARAN
shots.subject_placement: FATHER field and PARVARAN legible
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi writes the authorised value PARVARAN under FATHER after the longer pause.
shots.negative_constraints: no extra readable form fields; no title Doctor; no surname invention

shots.purpose: look toward open door and morning light before GUARDIAN
shots.framing: medium profile with door and window axes
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi foreground; open door and morning light share background depth
shots.orientation_notes: physical morning light only; no salvation symbolism
shots.visual_prompt: Before writing GUARDIAN, Anaadhi looks toward the physically open door and ordinary morning light; two court officers remain outside at respectful distance.
shots.negative_constraints: no heavenly beam; no glowing exit; no road visible as destiny; no officer intimidation
shots.continuity_anchor: GUARDIAN look toward open door and morning light

shots.purpose: write GUARDIAN NONE
shots.subject_placement: GUARDIAN field and NONE legible
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi writes the authorised value NONE under GUARDIAN.
shots.negative_constraints: no extra readable fields; no signature invention; no guardian name

shots.purpose: Clinician reads completed identity section
shots.subject_placement: Clinician reads; authorised fields low frame
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician reads the completed identity section without theatrical reaction.
shots.negative_constraints: no new readable text beyond NAME ANAADHI, MOTHER JANNE, FATHER PARVARAN, GUARDIAN NONE

shots.purpose: Clinician asks if Anaadhi is his choice of name
shots.subject_placement: Clinician center; form lower edge
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician asks whether continuing to call him Anaadhi is his choice.
shots.negative_constraints: no authority pressure; no invented diagnosis note
dialogue: INDEPENDENT CLINICIAN: Is it your choice that we continue to call you Anaadhi?

shots.purpose: Anaadhi answers yes
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi center
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi answers yes without dramatic emphasis.
shots.negative_constraints: no triumphant smile; no flashback; no alternate name graphic

shots.purpose: Clinician says his father chose the name
shots.subject_placement: Clinician right; Anaadhi left
shots.visual_prompt: Across the table, the Clinician notes that Anaadhi's father chose the name; no representation of Parvaran appears.
shots.negative_constraints: no Parvaran cutaway; no flashback; no father image
dialogue: INDEPENDENT CLINICIAN: Your father chose this name.

shots.purpose: Anaadhi says he chose the beginning
shots.framing: tight Anaadhi with intake form edge
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi center; form lower edge
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi answers that Parvaran chose the beginning, speaking without accusation or reconciliation spectacle.
shots.negative_constraints: no father apparition; no destiny graphics

shots.purpose: Anaadhi places pen down and decides whether name continues
shots.subject_placement: pen placed down foreground; Anaadhi face behind
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi places the pen down on the table and says he will decide whether the name continues.
shots.negative_constraints: no weapon association; no dramatic slam; no symbolic shattering
shots.continuity_anchor: I will decide whether it continues
dialogue: ANAADHI: I will decide whether it continues.

shots.purpose: Clinician opens first victim file
shots.subject_placement: first victim file opens between them
shots.depth_plan: file / Clinician hands / Anaadhi soft beyond
shots.orientation_notes: only first file enters active focus
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician opens the first victim file on the table, keeping all text except the later authorised printed name unreadable.
shots.negative_constraints: no stack of invented names; no crime photos; no sensational evidence spread

shots.purpose: Clinician asks where shall we begin
shots.subject_placement: Clinician center; file lower frame
shots.orientation_notes: invitation to begin with person, not category
shots.visual_prompt: The Clinician asks where they should begin, with the first victim file open between them.
shots.negative_constraints: no accusation pose; no invented file details
dialogue: INDEPENDENT CLINICIAN: Where shall we begin?

shots.purpose: reveal printed MALLAYYA in first victim file
shots.subject_placement: printed MALLAYYA legible; surrounding file text shallow/unreadable
shots.depth_plan: authorised name / paper texture / blurred table
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi's view of the first victim file: the printed name MALLAYYA is clearly readable and all other file copy remains unreadable.
shots.negative_constraints: no Salt Vendor label; no fabricated surname; no case number; no additional victim names

shots.purpose: Anaadhi says Mallayya—the man's name, not Salt Vendor
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi center with file edge low frame
shots.orientation_notes: sound is difficult and human; no category subtitle
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi looks at the printed name and says Mallayya. Keep the moment difficult and human rather than cathartic or heroic.
shots.negative_constraints: no Salt Vendor text; no victim apparition; no triumphant music; no tear exaggeration

shots.purpose: Anaadhi turns palm upward and keeps it open
shots.subject_placement: open palm centered; first victim file and pen peripheral
shots.orientation_notes: physical open hand; no supernatural signification
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi turns his palm upward on the table and leaves it open beside the pen and first victim file.
shots.negative_constraints: no weapon; no clenched fist; no glowing hand; no symbolic markings; no fresh wound

shots.purpose: final ordinary four-road convergence and open-palm hold to FADE OUT
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi open hand foreground/table edge; wide window reveals exactly four physical roads beyond grounds with ordinary vehicles moving in different directions
shots.depth_plan: open palm / window / IJMC grounds / four roads + vehicles
shots.orientation_notes: ENV-IJM-004 physical exterior; no road is salvation or destiny
shots.visual_prompt: Final physical image: Anaadhi's hand remains open on the table while the wide window shows exactly four ordinary roads meeting beyond the Independent Judicial Medical Centre grounds; normal vehicles travel in different directions. Nothing labels any road as salvation, destiny or the correct path.
shots.negative_constraints: no fifth road; no GF04 branch; no supernatural split; no road labels; no glowing path; no empty utopian road; no heroic skyline; no Paraane emblem
shots.continuity_anchor: ENV-IJM-004 / exactly four ordinary roads / FADE OUT
bgm: no mandatory heroic resolution; allow restrained final sustain only if creator-approved later
